dataset_name: RAG Evaluation Set — Curriculum and ML Systems Book
purpose: Evaluate document-only retrieval, grounded answering, source citation, and abstention for the Streamlit RAG application.
source_documents: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: Who is the AI/ML/GenAI training curriculum designed for?
cases.expected_answer: Data analysts, software engineers, AI practitioners, and technology professionals seeking end-to-end AI, ML, and GenAI skills.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What background knowledge does the curriculum recommend before starting?
cases.expected_answer: A basic understanding of programming, preferably Python, and familiarity with handling data; it is still intended to be accessible to motivated beginners.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: How long is the curriculum and when are classes held?
cases.expected_answer: It is a three-month hands-on program, with classes on Saturday and Sunday for about 2.5 to 3 hours.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: Which approaches to hyperparameter tuning are covered in Module 6?
cases.expected_answer: Grid search, random search, and Bayesian tuning.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What NLP techniques and concepts are listed in Module 8?
cases.expected_answer: Text preprocessing and feature extraction, Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF, embeddings, transformer basics, and an introduction to Hugging Face models.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: Which vector databases are named in the LLM Development Tools module?
cases.expected_answer: Pinecone, FAISS, and Chroma.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What does Module 11 cover in addition to building AI agents?
cases.expected_answer: Model monitoring and logging, integrating RAG and agents in apps, fine-tuning, and guardrails.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What must the capstone project integrate?
cases.expected_answer: An LLM, RAG, AI agents, deployment, and a presentation; it also includes current GenAI trends and MCP understanding.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: Which module introduces Retrieval Augmented Generation and what is its learning outcome?
cases.expected_answer: Module 10. Its outcome is to design, build, and integrate LLM solutions using LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: Which unsupervised-learning techniques are listed in Module 5?
cases.expected_answer: K-means, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, Apriori, FP-Growth, and PCA; the module also mentions anomaly-detection applications.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: Which neural-network architectures are named in the Deep Learning Fundamentals module?
cases.expected_answer: ANN basics, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What LLM topics are covered in Module 9?
cases.expected_answer: Python for GenAI, generative-AI and LLM basics, tokenization, embeddings, inference, and cloud and open-source LLMs.

expected_source.file: Swartek_AI_ML_GenAI_Curriculum.pdf

cases.question: What does NumPy provide, and what does SciPy add on top of it according to the book?
cases.expected_answer: NumPy provides optimized multidimensional arrays; SciPy uses those arrays to provide fast numerical routines.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: How does the book describe the general method of classification?
cases.expected_answer: It uses examples from each class to learn rules that can be applied to new examples.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: What classification problem involving flowers is used in Chapter 2?
cases.expected_answer: Determining whether a machine can distinguish flower species from images, using datasets with flower-morphology measurements and species labels.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: Why does the clustering chapter describe clustering as unsupervised learning?
cases.expected_answer: Because it addresses data without labels or correct classifications supplied by a teacher, so patterns must be found from the data itself.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: How does topic modeling differ from clustering in the book's example?
cases.expected_answer: Clustering places each text in one cluster, while topic modeling allows a document to relate to several topics with varying importance.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: What capability does the poor-answer classifier aim to provide to a user?
cases.expected_answer: It aims to evaluate a work-in-progress answer while the user is typing and provide feedback about signs that it may be poor.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: Why does the book say tweet sentiment analysis is particularly difficult?
cases.expected_answer: Tweets have a 140-character limit, which leads to special syntax, creative abbreviations, and often poorly formed sentences; normal paragraph-based analysis does not fit well.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: What regression problem is used at the start of the regression chapter?
cases.expected_answer: Predicting Boston house prices from demographic and geographical attributes, with the target being the median house value in an area.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: Why can a song not simply be represented like text for music-genre classification?
cases.expected_answer: A multi-minute song needs to be converted into suitable sound-based feature values; treating raw audio like text or a bag of sound bites would be too complex.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: What intermediate representation does the computer-vision chapter use before applying machine learning to images?
cases.expected_answer: It extracts numeric features from images before training a classifier such as an SVM.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: Give two reasons the book provides for dimensionality reduction.
cases.expected_answer: Any two of: irrelevant or redundant features can mislead models; more features mean more parameters and greater overfitting risk; fewer dimensions speed training; and visualization is limited to two or three dimensions.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf

cases.question: What tasks can the jug package perform in the Bigger Data chapter?
cases.expected_answer: It can break a pipeline into tasks, cache or memoize intermediate results, and use multiple cores or multiple computers on a grid.

expected_source.file: Building Machine Learning Systems with Python - Second Edition.pdf
